slot.brief: Give four small molecules/ions with their shapes and ask which one has a shape different from the rest (e.g. three bent, one linear or vice versa); pure VSEPR recall, no numbers.

stem: Three of the following species have trigonal planar molecular geometry. Which species is the odd one out?

verdicts.working: BF₃, NO₃⁻, and CO₃²⁻ are trigonal planar; NH₃ is trigonal pyramidal due to a lone pair on nitrogen.

working:
$\text{BF}_3$: AX$_3$, trigonal planar.
$\text{NH}_3$: AX$_3$E, trigonal pyramidal.
$\text{NO}_3^-$ and $\text{CO}_3^{2-}$: AX$_3$, trigonal planar.

Independent check: BF₃, NO₃⁻, and CO₃²⁻ are trigonal planar; NH₃ is trigonal pyramidal due to a lone pair on nitrogen.
solution:
By VSEPR theory, $\text{BF}_3$, $\text{NO}_3^-$, and $\text{CO}_3^{2-}$ are $AX_3$ species with trigonal planar geometry.
$\text{NH}_3$ is $AX_3E$; its lone pair gives it a trigonal pyramidal geometry, so it is the odd one out.
